atoms.text: Joy owns a clothing shop. This bar chart shows how many of each item are in her shop.

instruction.text: Which items does Joy have most of? Put the items in order from most to least.
Answer the following questions using the bar chart.

atoms.b: The scale on this bar chart goes up in steps of ((1 2 10 ++25 50)).

atoms.a: How many more trousers than shoes are in Joy’s shop?
What is the difference between the category with the most items and the one with the least?
Not including shoes or jewellery, how many pieces of clothing are there altogether?

instruction.text: Joy just found 100 jackets in the back of her shop. Finish filling in this bar chart to show this.
What is the total number of items in Joy’s shop?
